result.goal: Run one prospectively specified, mechanically judged comparison of two planning methods on three deterministically selected levels from an immutable external Sokoban corpus, producing new bounded planning evidence rather than repeating the exhausted software-repair target.

inputs.prospective_external_source: Resolve google-deepmind/boxoban-levels through the connected GitHub source; verify canonical repository identity, license, exact commit, and level-file format before use. No current source contents or availability are asserted by this Root decision.

protocol.baseline: Generic uniform-cost search over legal push states, with player reachability computed mechanically and deterministic up/right/down/left expansion order; exact state deduplication. No target-specific pruning.
protocol.budget: For each of3 locked levels run each frozen method once, in precommitted baseline/comparison order. Cap each run at50000 expanded states or60 seconds, whichever occurs first. Same interpreter, source, environment and counting rules. No automatic retry or extra budget after failure; accepted process ids are queried before any launch.
protocol.claim_boundary: External public corpus with mechanically checked behavior, operated in this same session. Not independent evaluation, fresh withheld-test assurance, previously unseen-task assurance, learned generalization, production performance or AGI.
protocol.comparison: A* on the same push-state graph with a goal-matching lower bound from reverse-push distances and static dead-square pruning. Heuristic/pruning rules must be generic and frozen before any selected level is solved, not fitted to held-out results.
protocol.comparison_rule: Report paired per-level results, solved counts and expansions. Support only bounded operational benefit if comparison solves at least as many locked levels, no invalid solution is accepted, and it strictly improves at least one paired solved outcome or expansion count without worsening any jointly solved level's expansion count. Otherwise report no support/negative/unevaluable, with no task removal. Do not infer population significance from3 levels.
protocol.judge: A separate simple move-transition replay validates each returned solution from the original board, legal moves, box positions and all-goals terminal condition. Retain raw actions, solved/unsolved/timeout/error, expansions, elapsed time and exact budget termination cause. Invalid solutions never count as solved.
protocol.precommit: Before any solving, durably publish corpus/file/level hashes, both solver implementation hashes, move order, limits, level selector and scoring plan. Do not change either solver, task selection or budgets after seeing trial results.
protocol.source_selection: At Execute, freeze one exact source commit and the first lexicographically ordered level file in the repository's published hard subset. Select the first three level records in file order without solving, preview-driven substitution, or difficulty-based filtering. If the stated subset/format is absent or unusable, record NOT_EVALUABLE; do not silently substitute corpus or target.
